_comment: Tags are the second axis. `group` is planning metadata only - it is stripped before the API call, because the tags table has name/slug/description and nothing else. Rules: every post carries exactly one platform tag per platform it covers, one-to-three topic tags, and at most one format tag. A tag with fewer than three posts is a thin archive; docs/16 noindexes those, so do not invent tags outside this file.
